# WP1-d: self-consolidation loop (no labels in the loop)

Alerts from detectors only (D1,AE; D1 = physics residual, AE = physics-informed autoencoder). Alarm runs closer than 120 s form one episode; synthesis uses the first 60 s. Family G: grid-wide invariants of the alert topology (one rule per topology); family S: state change. Certification: search and robust exact layer (linearised AC); CEGIS on margins. A rule acts only after the time it was learned. Wall time 96 s.
